Foundation shades sold at Sephora and Ulta

foundation_shades.Rd

Foundation shades scraped from the Sephora and Ulta websites, with the colour of each shade's swatch summarised as HSL values. Each row is one shade of one product.

Usage

foundation_shades

Format

A data frame with 6,774 rows and 8 columns:

brand

Brand name

product

Product name

retailer

Retailer the product was collected from: "Sephora" or "Ulta"

shade

Shade description as shown on the product page

hex

Hexadecimal code of the most prevalent colour in the shade's swatch image

hue

HSL hue, in degrees from 0 to 360

sat

HSL saturation, from 0 to 1

lightness

HSL lightness, from 0 (black) to 1 (white)

Source

The Pudding, "The Naked Truth" (2021), by Ofunne Amaka and Amber Thomas, https://pudding.cool/2021/03/foundation-names/. Data released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/the-pudding/data, accessed via TidyTuesday (2021-03-30), https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2021/2021-03-30.

Details

The data were collected in early 2021 and reflect the products listed on each retailer's website at that time. Colour values come from swatch images rather than measured product colour, so they are approximate. Shades listed twice within the same product were removed during preparation; see data-raw/foundation_shades.R.

The data describe shade supply only. They contain no information on sales, prices or the number of customers with each skin tone.
